meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: Claude 会多出两个工具:一个列出 Atomic Chat 本地桌面应用里当前可用的模型,另一个把提示词发给指定模型并返回回答。Claude 仍是主控,把活分给本地模型做。
howto.when: 当你提到 Atomic Chat、要求用本地模型作答,或点名 atomic_chat_generate 等工具时,它会调用这些工具。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都是哪里
say.note: 会先列模型再生成回答

say.text: atomic chat 里现在有哪些模型可用?
用 atomic chat 的模型回答:什么是闭包?
say.note: 报 model not found 就先列模型确认 ID

howto.what_en: Claude gains two tools: one lists models available in the local Atomic Chat desktop app, the other sends a prompt to a chosen model and returns its reply. Claude still orchestrates, offloading work to local models.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention Atomic Chat, ask for a local model to answer, or name tools like atomic_chat_generate.

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Lists models, then generates an answer

say_en.text: Which models are available in atomic chat right now?
Ask an atomic chat model: what is a closure?
say_en.note: If model not found, list models for exact ID
